title.narrative: Integrated HIV/AIDS and TB response in Guinea-Bissau - Guinea-Bissau (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Guinea-Bissau, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Guinea-Bissau (MINSAP)This program has the following goals: Réduire de 36% du taux de l’incidence (par rapport à 2018) de la tuberculose d'ici 2024 / Reduce by 36% the incidence rate (compared to 2018) of tuberculosis by 2024. Réduire de 35% du nombre de décès dus à la TB (par rapport à 2018) d'ici 2024 / Reduce TB deaths by 35% (compared to 2018) by 2024. Réduire les nouvelles infections à VIH de 50% d'ici 2023 par rapport au niveau de 2017 / Reduce new HIV infections by 50% from 2017 levels by 2023. Réduire de 90% d'ici 2023 le nombre de décès liés au VIH par rapport au niveau de 2017 / Reduce the number of HIV-related deaths by 90% from 2017 levels by 2023. The objectives of this program are: Augmenter la couverture de traitement des nouveaux cas de tuberculose en passant de 30% cas en 2018 à 90% cas en 2024 / Increase treatment coverage of new TB cases from 30% in 2018 to 90% in 2024. Traiter 100% des patients diagnostiqués et augmenter le taux de succès de traitement à au moins 90% pour la TB sensible et 75% pour la TB-MR jusqu’en 2024 / Treat 100% of diagnosed patients and increase the treatment success rate to at least 90% for susceptible TB and 75% for MDR-TB until 2024. Offrir la prévention TB à au moins 90% des enfants contacts et des PvVIH après exclusion de la TB maladie d’ici 2024 / Provide TB prevention to at least 90% of contacts' choldren and PLHIVs after exclusion from TB disease by 2024. Dépister et prendre en charge 100% des patients TB pour le VIH (test VIH et traitement ARV) / Screening and management of 100% of TB patients for HIV (HIV test and ARV treatment). Les comportements à moindre risque sont adoptés par 70% de la population clés (PS et HSH), d'ici 2023 / 70% of the key population (SW and MSM) adopt low-risk behaviors by 2023. Les comportements à moindre risque sont adoptés par 70% de populations âgée de 15 ans et plus, y compris les populations vulnérables (adolescents, jeunes de 15-24 ans, filles vendeuses, hommes en tenu, chauffeurs, pécheurs et marins, migrants et refugiés), d'ici 2023 / 70% of populations aged 15 and over, including vulnerable populations (adolescents, young people aged 15-24, girl vendors, men in uniform, drivers, fishermen and seafarers, migrants and refugees) adopt low-risk behaviors by 2023. Les services de PTME de qualité pendant la grossesse, l'accouchement et l'allaitement, sont assurés à 95% des femmes enceintes séropositives, d'ici 2023 / Quality PMTCT services during pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding are provided to 95% of HIV-positive pregnant women by 2023. Le traitement ARV est garanti à 90% de PVVIH (adultes et enfants) éligibles, d’ici 2023 / ARV treatment is guaranteed to 90% of eligible PLHIVs (adults and children) by 2023. Le traitement ARV est assuré à 100% des enfants séropositifs éligibles / ARV treatment is provided to 100% of eligible HIV-positive children. La prise en charge des co-morbidités (TB/VIH, paludisme/VIH et hépatite B ou C/VIH) est assurée à 80% PVVIH adultes et enfants, d’ici 2023 / The management of co-morbidities (TB/HIV, malaria/HIV and hepatitis B or C/HIV) is provided to 80% of PLHIV adults and children by 2023. Assurer une meilleure gestion des Programmes (TB, VIH et RSSH) à tous les niveaux (suivi et évaluation, collecte et exploitation des données pour la planification) / Ensure better management of Programs (TB, HIV and RSSH) at all levels (monitoring and evaluation, data collection and use for planning)

Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status

Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period

LAB-Other 1: Percentage of laboratories with adequate quality control performance
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results

Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

Percentage of men who have sex with men that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases

Percentage of men reporting using a condom the last time they had anal sex with a male partner
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed

Percentage of people living with HIV not on ART at the end of the reporting period among people living with HIV who were either on ART at the end of the last reporting period or newly initiated on ART during the reporting period
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Percentage of sex workers reporting using a condom with their most recent client

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
